title: An Efficient iLQR Algorithm for Optimal Control with Bounded States and Inputs: Application to Spacecraft Maneuvers
summary: This paper presents a constrained iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (Box-iLQR) method for nonlinear aerospace optimal-control problems with bounded states and controls. Logarithmic barrier functions are used with a two-fold objective: the barrier parameter is reduced toward zero to recover the constrained optimal trajectory, while a finite barrier is retained to construct a smooth, constraint-aware feedback policy for closed-loop operation.
